A '''copper pickaxe''' is the [[Copper equipment|copper]] [[Tools#Pickaxe|pickaxe]], crafted from [[Copper Ingot|copper ingots]]. It mines at speed 6 and has 350 durability.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/copper_pickaxe.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}

The vanilla recipe is blocked and replaced by the pack's own, which gives the item the stats listed below.

=== Loot ===
{{Sources}}

The loot table <code>matcha:equipment/copper/pickaxe</code> gives the item exactly as crafted; it is used by <code>/loot</code> and by the [[Updating items|item update system]].

== Usage ==

=== Mining ===

It mines pickaxe blocks at speed 6 (vanilla: 5).

It cannot get drops from diamond ore, [[Native Gold|native gold]] or obsidian-based blocks (obsidian, crying obsidian and ender chests), which it breaks at speed 3 without dropping anything.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/tags/block/non_mineable/copper.json}}</ref>

=== Combat ===

It deals 3 damage with an attack speed of 1.2.

=== Repairing ===

It is repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[Copper Ingot|copper ingots]]. Matcha Flavoured removes the repair cost limit, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Smelting ingredient ===
In a [[Blast Furnace|blast furnace]], it smelts into one [[Copper Ingot|copper ingot]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blast/copper_ingot_from_blasting_copper_materials.json}}</ref>
